**Tracing Process:**
1. Extracted all requirements from PRD (functional + non-functional)
2. Searched architecture.md for relevant sections (keywords: "error boundary", "god store", "AI service", "BYOK", "security")
3. Cross-referenced with ADRs (ADR-026 through ADR-029)
4. Searched UX specification for UI-related requirements (keywords: "mobile", "accessibility", "responsive", "error handling")
5. Documented gaps where no coverage found
6. Assessed severity based on priority tier (P0 > P1 > P2 > P3)

**Validation:**
- Manual review of all 63 requirements
- Cross-checked evidence references (file:line format)
- Verified P0/P1 coverage = 100%
- Confirmed gap severity ratings
